clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the year: your mother lying awake over money in March 1988, then stopping talk with your father about it by May 1988; your brother's grades fell in November 1989; your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990, where it settles.

clusters.name: You leaving home and your mother's diagnosis, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your leaving for college in September 1993 and your mother's breast cancer diagnosis in February 1995, within these years: you had migraines keeping you in bed by March 1994, called your brother most nights by April 1994, then stopped returning his calls by June 1995 and stopped calling home by February 1996, where it settles; every shift in these months is yours or between you and your brother, and your mother's shifts show only as the event itself.
